title: Tomba LinkedIn Finder Input
description: Input configuration for Tomba LinkedIn Finder Actor - Convert LinkedIn profiles to verified email addresses

linkedinUrls.title: LinkedIn URLs
linkedinUrls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe. URLs without www., with a country subdomain (uk.linkedin.com) or with a query string are accepted.

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of LinkedIn profiles to process

enrichMobile.title: Find phone numbers
enrichMobile.description: Also return the phone numbers linked to each profile (in `phone_data` and `phoneNumbers`). A profile with phone data costs 6 credits instead of 1.

full.title: Return all stored addresses
full.description: Return every email address Tomba has stored for the profile (up to 2) instead of the best one. You get one row and pay 1 credit per returned address, plus 5 credits per phone number when phone numbers are enabled.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional URL that Tomba also sends each result to (sent as `webhook_url`). Must start with http:// or https://.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many Tomba requests run in parallel. There is no rate limit, so raise it for large lists.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Concurrency, retry and cache settings. The defaults work well for most runs.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request after a network error, 429 or 5xx response (exponential backoff). Failed requests are never charged.

useCache.title: Use cache
useCache.description: Reuse results from previous runs for identical requests. Cached results are free.

cacheTtlHours.title: Cache TTL (hours)
cacheTtlHours.description: How long cached results stay valid. 0 disables the cross-run cache.
